newsitem.title: USA: Correctional Services to post Q4 write-off.
newsitem.headline: Correctional Services to post Q4 write-off.

text.p: Correctional Services Corp said Thursday it will report a fourth quarter 1996 write-off approaching $3.5 million pre-tax in connection with plans to discontinue one community corrections program and re-configure another.
The company said it will discontinue its Fort Worth, Texas community corrections program and re-configure its New York State community corrections program.
The write-off reflects the re-valuation of certain intangible assets and the provision for costs associated with the two corrections' programs.
In Fort Worth, the state of Texas was unable to assure an increase in the facility's population, which averaged about 50 percent of capacity in 1996, the company said.

In New York, the company said it has recently experienced a reduction in population as a result of a significant decline in the use of work-release services by the state. The company said it believes this situation is unlikely to improve.
